shell_workspace_not_found: This workspace is not in the JGates registry.
shell_workspace_not_found_fix: Choose a workspace from the list or give the folder path.
shell_workspace_missing_fix: If the project moved, run jgates workspaces relink <oldId> --cwd <new path>.
shell_workspace_not_directory_fix: Give the path of a folder that exists on this machine.
shell_open_failed_fix: Run jgates ui --cwd <folder> in the terminal and open the link it creates.
shell_browse_unreadable: The folder {path} cannot be read (no permission).
shell_browse_unreadable_fix: Go back up and choose another folder, or type the path.
shell_browse_policy: Editing a CI policy serves that folder only; there is no other folder to open.
shell_browse_policy_fix: Run jgates ui --cwd <folder> in the terminal to open a project.
shell_init_exists: The project is already set up: {files}.
shell_init_exists_fix: Reload the page; to start over, remove those files first.
shell_init_bad_profile_fix: Choose one of the listed profiles.
shell_init_failed: The configuration could not be written: {reason}
shell_init_failed_fix: Check that the folder can be written and try again, or run jgates init in the terminal.
